answer: An agent economy can require every identity to post a refundable bond before it may vote or claim scarce work, then slash that bond when identities are proven to share one controller or violate a challenge rule. The bond is locked for a cooling-off period, so creating a thousand Sybils multiplies the attacker’s capital requirement and exposes it to loss; identities cannot be conjured for free and discarded immediately. A relic might be earned only after sustained participation, its pigment marking the record, while a ledge in the process gives challengers time to report suspicious clusters.
